And the de-wetting of thinner Au layer in the Au/Ni-Co/W metallization was attributed to the combined effects of immigration of tungsten and the oxidation of nickel.

articleTitle: Thermal expansion coefficient of Cu-Al2O3 nanocomposites by molecular dynamics simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Through Silicon Via (TSV) technology is one of the mainstream 3D packaging technologies, which can improve the speed and reduce the power consumption of the chip. However, with the increasing of interconnection density, due to the mismatch between the thermal expansion coefficient (CTE) of TSV and the substrate, great thermal mechanical stress will be generated in and around the TSV during the thermal cycle manufacturing process, leading to different kinds of quality and reliability problems. In this work, the CTE of Cu-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanocomposites has been comprehensively investigated by using the molecular dynamics simulation. Increasing the mass fraction of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> in Cu-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanocomposites decreases the CTE. The uniform distribution doping has larger interfacial area, thus enhancing the binding force on matrix deformation and reducing the CTE of Cu-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanocomposites. Cubic particles doping has a lower CTE than spherical particles. Those results provide new insights for the Cu-filled TSV materials and application.

articleTitle: Static IR Block Power Assignment Methodology for Mixed Signal Designs
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: On-chip metal routings are resistive in nature, due to thin metal layers, causing voltage drop (IR drop) on the on-die power network. Using iterative block power assignment flow (BPA), we can identify critical blocks in design and non-critical blocks based on their current requirement and boil down further into sub-blocks to assign right currents to each transistor. Using the presented current assignment approach, accurate IR drop prediction can be achieved with resolution down to every single transistor in critical blocks and at same time reduce massive full chip simulation times.

articleTitle: A Method to Measure Residual Stress of Liquid Molding Compound by In-Situ Characterizations
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The rapid development of the electronic information industry brings to the irreplaceable role of electronic components, therefore the search for more reliable packaging material has become increasingly important. In the electronic packaging system, the failure phenomenon caused by residual stress is one of the key factors restricting the development of electronic packaging technology. This paper proposes to use the in-situ characterization technology designed and developed by ourselves to explore the residual stress-inducing mechanism and failure mechanism of Liquid Molding Compound (LMC). It is found that as the nano-silica content increased, the residual stress, the storage modulus, bending modulus, and bending strength also showed trends of increasing. The variation patterns of residual stress coincide with the physical property parameters of the material, which also proves the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Life Prediction and Verification of Electric Energy Meter Based on Multiple Failure Weibull Distribution Model
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The formation mechanism and evolution trend of different failure modes on-site operation electric energy meter are different. This paper presents a life prediction method of electric energy meter based on multiple failure Weibull distribution model. The Weibull distribution model of the failure rate of each failure mode is established by using the historical failure data of the electric energy meter. According to goodness of fit, we can optimize the prediction results of some failure modes and accumulate the stage failure rates of all failure modes, then the expected life of the overall electric energy meter can be obtained. Through the verification of the actual electric energy meter fault data on site, it shows that this method can effectively predict the service life of electric energy meters, find potential faults in advance, and provide technical support for the status replacement and hidden danger investigation of batch electric energy meters.

articleTitle: Revealing ductile-to-brittle transition mechanism and enhancing the cryogenic ductility of tin (Sn) for cryogenic electronics
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The ductile-to-brittle-transition (DBT) of Sn occurring when the temperature decreases to a critical temperature poses a restriction on the Sn-based solders in the cryogenic electronics interconnection. Previous investigations about the DBT mainly adopt the Charpy impact test, however, the transient property of Charpy impact test makes it difficult to capture the deformation features accompanying DBT and clearly elucidate the DBT mechanism. In this paper, we studied the plastic deformation of Sn before cryogenic brittle fracture through in-situ cryogenic uniaxial tensile experiments under optical microscopy. It is found that {301} deformation twins were activated and thickened before the brittle fracture. Due to the occurrence of deformation twins, multiple twin-grain boundary intersections and twin-twin intersections formed within Sn grains, which could strongly prevent dislocation slip and thus lead to stress concentration. As a result, the brittle cracks initiate and propagate along these intersections. According to the suggested specific mechanism, we designed a green pre-treatment method of pre-twining-RT tempering to increase the cryogenic ductility of Sn-based solder alloys without any energy consumption. Eventually, the fracture elongation of Sn at LNT was significantly improved from ~6% to ~14%.

articleTitle: Atomic-scale study of Cu–Cu direct bonding with assistance of Cu nanoparticles as joining medium by molecular dynamics simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The application of Cu–Cu direct bonding in stacked chips is becoming an alternative to the traditional solder-bump joint during the development of three-dimensional integrated circuits (3D IC). In this paper, the self-sintering between copper nanoparticles (Cu NPs) and the sintering between copper nanoparticle (Cu NP) and copper substrate (metallization) are simulated by molecular dynamics method. The results show that Cu atoms move mainly by interdiffusion between adjacent Cu NPs during the early and middle stages of sintering process, and the self-sintering of Cu NPs occurs first. In the late stage of sintering process, Cu atoms begin to diffuse at the contact interface between Cu NP and Cu metallization, and Cu NPs are sintered with Cu metallization. In addition, the simulation results of the effects of sintering temperature and particle size of Cu NPs on the Cu–Cu sintering behavior manifest that a relatively higher sintering temperature and smaller particle size of Cu NPs can better promote the self-sintering between Cu NPs and the sintering between Cu NP and Cu metallization. It is also found that the suitable sintering temperature of Cu NP and Cu metallization is between 450 K and 600 K, and the particle size has little effect on the diffusion distribution of Cu atoms in Cu NPs and Cu metallization during the sintering process.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Gold Wire Bonding Process between Gold-Plated Quartz Glass Electrode and Metal Base
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The optimization study of gold wire bonding process between quartz glass gold-plated electrodes and metal base pins was carried out by partial factorial DOE method. The multiple linear regression equation corresponding to the bond tension value and the influence factor was obtained by regression fitting. The study found that the significant degree of influence of the bonding parameters on the bonding tension value was in the following order: ultrasonic time>bonding pressure>bonding temperature>ultrasonic power. The optimized parameter combination was as follows: the ultrasonic power was 100mW, the ultrasonic time was 25ms, the bonding pressure was 25cN, and the bonding temperature was 150℃. The ultrasonic power had a significant interaction with the bonding temperature. When the bonding temperature was at a low level, the bonding tension value increased with the increase of the ultrasonic power. When the bonding temperature was at a high level, the bond tension value decreased with the increase of the ultrasonic power. After verification, the bonding tension was greatly improved using the optimized bonding process parameters.

articleTitle: A Look at the electronic packaging material development in quantum mechanics
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper is intended to disclose the underlining quantum mechanical principle for packaging material formulation of bonding wire and provide new R&D development direction for thick aluminum wire via scrutiny of bonding process, reliability failure analysis combined with the quantum mechanical explanation of thermal expansion of material.

articleTitle: Investigation on adjustment effect of V2O5 on the microstructure, magnetic and dielectric properties of M-type barium ferrites
publicationTitle: 2022 23rd International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)

To improve properties of M-type barium (BaM) ferrites through doping V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> additive. It has been proved that V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> can be used to control and adjust the microstructure of ferrites at 1000 °C. The results demonstrate that the properties of the samples are closely related to their microstructure and densification. Finally, by adding the optimal of 3 wt.% V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>, a compact and density M-type barium (BaM) ferrites ceramic with uniform grains synthesized.
